_note: V5.3 a, the regional development fund (docs/design/v5.3-ab.md 3.3 (a), src/sim/region_funds.gd). STAND-INS written by Systems so the verb can be measured; Content authors the numbers (the spec's section 10). share_pct: the levels a fund runs at, percent of the region's output a year, [lowest, highest], STAND-INS (the author, 2026-11-09: the same choice is the same effort everywhere; the bill is that share of the region's output at the opening, in euros). years: how long it may run, whole years, [shortest, longest]. bloc_offset_per_bn: what each bn a year of a fund moves at its start, scaled by the funded region's share of the nation's population (the blocs are national, a fund is not): the region's workers and the rural vote gain, the city vote pays a little for a transfer it does not receive.
